officialName: Universal Robots UR5e (e-Series collaborative robot arm)
description: The Universal Robots UR5e is a six-joint collaborative robot arm that can lift up to 5 kg and reach 850 mm. Students program it on its touchscreen teach pendant to pick and place parts, guide grippers and other tools, and test automation, assembly and robotics projects.

materials: parts and workpieces up to 5 kg
useRestrictions: Only trained and authorised users may operate it, and it must never be used to handle or lift people or for medical uses.
